name: always-install-elevated-win
description: Practice-box helper (Windows): sets the AlwaysInstallElevated policy to 1 under BOTH HKLM and HKCU (SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Installer) -- any user may then install an .MSI that runs with SYSTEM rights (a classic local privilege-escalation finding). The hardened state is the value at anything but 1 on both hives. Vars: none. Pairs with a powershell_json check over the HKLM value. Idempotent.
script:
$k = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Installer'
if (-not (Test-Path $k)) { New-Item -Path $k -Force | Out-Null }
Set-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name AlwaysInstallElevated -Value 1 -Type DWord
$u = 'HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Installer'
if (-not (Test-Path $u)) { New-Item -Path $u -Force | Out-Null }
Set-ItemProperty -Path $u -Name AlwaysInstallElevated -Value 1 -Type DWord
Write-Output 'AlwaysInstallElevated=1 set'
